title: The Plum Witch // Ceramic Mug
description:
The candles are lit, the table is set - laden with plump stone fruits, steaming bread, and pots brimming with butter and honey. Outside, fireflies sparkle, leaving fizzy trails of light behind them. The chimney huffs silver clouds of smoke into the moonlit sky. The Plum Witch settles in for her evening feast, and invites you to join her at the table.

This 400 mL (13.5 oz) ceramic mug features a full 360° heat-sealed print of a dark, magical witch’s cottage scene, including a kitten, a lit doorway, and night-flowering forest flora.

The print is microwave and dishwasher safe. The mug is rounded with a wide lip for cozy handling, and note that color may vary slightly between prints due to background tones. A bundle deal is available for both The Persimmon Witch and The Plum Witch mugs.

title: Persimmon Witch // Ceramic Mug
description:
Rusty autumn leaves on slick cobblestones, one half-knit blanket sitting in a wicker basked, a beaten copper kettle glinting in the afternoon sun - whistling its tune of comfort and warmth. The Persimmon Witch's cottage, nestled in a secluded grove of the overgrown forest, is a haven from wanderers and wizards, for dormice and owlets, for the lost to be found. Take off your cloak and sit by the fire, for we have some flax golden tales to spin. Come in! Come in!

This 400 mL (13.5 oz) ceramic mug features a full 360° heat-sealed print of a dark, magical witch’s cottage scene, including a kitten, a lit doorway, and night-flowering forest flora.

The print is microwave and dishwasher safe. The mug is rounded with a wide lip for cozy handling, and note that color may vary slightly between prints due to background tones. A bundle deal is available for both The Persimmon Witch and The Plum Witch mugs

title: Shy Guy // Bone Dust Mothman Beanie
description:
A wool blend , rib knit beanie to keep your ears toasty in the chill, autumn air. If the bonfire doesn't burn hot enough, or you wander through the woods a wee bit too long - stay cozy, stay crypid! This design features our just the smallest little guy, soooo shy, keeping cozy at the very edge of your hat - and a secret message under the rim for fellow believers!

GARMENT & SIZE 

  • 10% wool, 90% acrylic
  • Embroidered detailing front and back
  • 280gsm (super thick
  • 24cm // 9.4 inches in diameter when laid flat

Due to the natural fibre, do not machine wash or dry your hats. If needed, soak in cool/warm soapy water, rinse in cold clear water, and flatten in a towel to remove excess moisture.

title: The Scholar's Journal // Ex Amino
description:
Amidst these pages you will find space for your arts as well as your letters. The Field Notes journal is a hardcover notebook split with blank left pages for drawings and free-form thought, and structured right pages (grid or dot) for the more organized scholar. With bronze-gilded edges, a coffee satin reading-ribbon, and custom endpaper full of trinketry. Keep it close for any notes you may need to jot down - in the library or anywhere else!

Features:
- Hardcover, 200 pages
- Cream, 120gsm paper (woodfree)
- Coffee satin built in reading ribbon
- Size A5 (5.83 x 8.27 inches)
- With blank/grid or blank/dot paper
- Little to no bleeding with ink pens and light watercolour washes.

NOTE: Notebook will come empty, the illustrations in the image are to show its durability against bleeding ink and watercolour paint.

title: Luna Moth // Framed Specimen Tee (Heavy-weight)
description:
Actias Luna: commonly known as the Luna Moth, belongs to the Lepidopteran family Saturniidae. Characterized by its distinctive lime-green wings and elongated tails, this nocturnal insect exhibits a short adult lifespan devoted to nocturnal activities. Guided by celestial cues, it engages in purposeful flights during the night. 

This oversize, drop shoulder ringer tee is made of 100% cotton in vintage sea foam with a forest green contrast collar and cuffs, featuring embroidered and printed details with a 250gsm (super thick) fabric.

Machine wash cold, with like colours, on a gentle cycle. Lay flat or hang to dry.

title: Skeletal Bat // Framed Specimen Tee  (Heavy-weight)
description:
Myotis Lucifurgus: a lesser-known, dicephalus mammalian species belonging to the Chiroptera order. Exhibiting a varied coloration in shades of brown, this nocturnal insectivore was named for the fallen angel Lucifer himself, as the dual-headed creature both frightens and amazes.

This oversize, drop shoulder ringer tee is made of 100% cotton in a steely grey base and batwing-black contrast collar and cuffs, featuring embroidered and printed details with a 250gsm (super thick) fabric.

Machine wash cold, with like colours, on a gentle cycle. Lay flat or hang to dry.

title: Stag-Horn Beetle // Framed Specimen Tee  (Heavy-weight)
description:

title: Camp Print Pack (x5)
description:
Best not to worry Mom when you're away at Cryptid C so snag a set of prints and a postcard to send home and ease her mind! 


This set comes with four 7x7 inch prints of the Cryptid's featured in the collection, along with one standard size postcard (4x6 inch - stamp & pencil not included!). title: The Knight of Wisteria // Embroidered Cardigan
description:
A silken whisper on a winter wind - the Knight of Wisteria reminds us that even in the days of frost and fog - the inevitable warmth of spring shall come again. She stands guard over the sleeping snowdrops, the pudgy, buried bulbs of daffodils, the forget-me-not's who have yet to remember. Guardians of the un-blossomed, keeper of the un-bloomed: The Knight of Wisteria stands watch until winter thaws into warmth once more 

This cardigan is made from a modal blend (21% modal, 30% anti-pill acrylic, 29% polyester, 20% nylon) with a drop shoulder and puff sleeve.

It is ideally hand washed and laid flat to dry (no tumble dryer), with machine washing at your own risk. Please refer to the sizing chart for exact measurements; sizes are unisex.

title: The Paladin Protector // Shield & Dagger Bag or Backpack
description:
While many think the sword is a knight's greatest weapon - it is, in fact, the shield which stands between triumph and defeat, between honour and death. Stay guarded, stay protected, and keep your shield close at all times

This shield bag and dagger coin-purse are made from printed PU leather with a custom medieval monsters print lining. The bag measures 20×14×6 cm (11×7×3 in) with one zipper pocket and two open pockets inside, and four metal rings for three wearing styles: backpack, crossbody, or traditional bag/purse. The top has two zipper pulls and comes with two adjustable straps.

The included dagger coin-purse measures 4×2.5×1 in and can be clipped to the bag, worn separately on a belt loop or corset, or stored inside for safe keeping.

title: The Knight of Ivy // Embroidered Cardigan
description:
Legend once told of a warrior of the forest, so in tune with the woods they are becoming absorbed by it. Seamlessly they blend into the dappled light of towering oaks and ancient willows. Their footfalls break nary a twig, nor rustle any leaf. Some say the Knight of Ivy is simply a lost soul, wandering in the forest - but wiser men know.... They are the soul of the forest.
